name: benchname-project-level-code-completion
description:
🥷 BenchName (Project-level code completion)
	

This is the benchmark for Project-level code completion task as part of the 🥷 BenchName benchmark.
Each datapoint contains the file for completion, a list of lines to complete with their categories (see the categorization below), and a repository snapshot that can be used to build the context.
All the repositories are published under permissive licenses (MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD-3-Clause, and BSD-2-Clause). The datapoints can be removed upon… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/anon-iclr-submission/benchname-project-level-code-completion.
reputation: Available on Hugging Face and used in recent research on project-level code completion, but not yet a widely adopted standard benchmark.
